observed: Rive documents per-vertex color charts, independent vector handle weights and stage drag adjustment. Its weights total 100% and its broader tooling includes smoothing, auto weights and locks.
WCAG dragging guidance calls for a single-pointer alternative; keyboard-only dragging support does not meet that requirement.
Blender brush documentation request was rejected with HTTP 403; it supplies no implementation evidence.
productChoices: Expose a bounded target-weight brush plus explicit numeric per-vertex application in a bottom sheet. This is an Evir interaction choice; the cited Rive page documents its own stage-drag tool.
Use a swept maximum footprint with a fixed screen radius; each stroke applies from a frozen baseline so event count and stationary dwell do not build up influence.
Support existing path/control and textured-mesh skin contracts, one to four bound bones and largest-remainder 255-byte normalization.
Keep brush settings/overlay session-only; retain source geometry and asset bytes.
Auto weights, smoothing, per-bone influence locks and generalized IK remain open.
